name: Essay / Long read
description: A longer argument or reflection: intro, a couple of sections, a pull-quote, a close.

blocks.html: Open with the central idea, plainly. One or two sentences is enough — say what this is about and why it is worth a few minutes.
Make the point, then back it with a concrete example or a bit of evidence. Keep one idea per section.
Build on the first, or push against it. The turn is usually where a piece earns its length.
Lift one line that carries the argument — a sentence a reader could quote back to you.
Close with what follows from all this: a practical implication, an open question, or a position you are willing to defend.
